tracked: JSON measurement records, protocols, audit reports, and checksums
excluded_from_all_branch_histories: Results NPZ arrays, compressed profiler traces, source archives, and console logs
local_preservation: Removed artifacts remain byte-for-byte at their original local paths. A verified Git bundle preserves the pre-cleanup history outside the repository.
remote_artifacts: Per-job request.json records identify the existing Modal output volumes; no new GPU runs or storage migration were performed.
checksum_manifests: Manifests describe the original full experiment artifact set, including excluded local/Modal files. GitHub checkouts intentionally contain only the tracked subset.
commit_provenance: history-rewrite-map.json maps original experimental source commit IDs to equivalent cleaned revisions.
lfs: No LFS pointers or .gitattributes are added; generated artifacts are excluded rather than migrated to LFS.
